text: To Michael the loneliness was dreadful. “If only something would make a sound!” he cried. As if in answer to his request, the air was rent by the most tremendous crash he had ever heard. The pirates had fired Long Tom at them. The roar of it echoed through the mountains, and the echoes seemed to cry savagely, “Where are they, where are they, where are they?” Thus sharply did the terrified three learn the difference between an island of make-believe and the same island come true.
